<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Without an Emperor, the Imperial Guard will eventually fall apart.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|— ''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 14}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Teach Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[General Teach]] is a high-ranking military leader within the [[Imperial Guard]] who serves the Emperor with intense devotion. Clad in red-and-black plated armor, she wields a [[sword]] known as [[Tyrfang]], an object that radiates an [[aura]] of death and slaughter. Teach is characterized by a disciplined, rigid demeanor and a lack of interest in compliments, though she has shown rare moments of empathy toward others. Her history includes suppressing a rebellion, an act that continues to haunt her conscience. Despite this past, she remains fiercely committed to the stability of [[The Empire|the Empire]] and the preservation of its leadership. She has expressed a willingness to die to protect the [[throne]] or to signal when an Emperor's sanity has been lost. Throughout her service, she has demonstrated significant combat prowess and leadership, though she has also undergone physical transformations, appearing in a purple-and-blue form. She is accompanied by a [[Kameira]] with glittering [[scales]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Teach possesses silver-and-blue eyes. Following a blow from [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]], her hair was entirely burned away.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Described as being just an animal, Teach is a dangerous individual. She holds the belief that the [[Imperial Guard]] will collapse if they lack an Emperor.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Teach utilizes a weapon known as [[Tyrfang]] and can pump power from her [[Vessel]] into it. She also possesses various enhancements and is capable of performing physical maneuvers like a shoulder-tackle.}}
